request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Article 71(11) of Legislative Decree 81/2008 allows the periodic verifications after the first one to be carried out by ARPA where a regional law so provides. Which regional law of Sardinia, where the IGEA devices are located, assigns these verifications to ARPA?

response.text: {"kind": "unknown", "value": null, "text": "The documents do not name any Sardinian regional law assigning the periodic verifications to ARPA. Article 71(11) of D.Lgs. 81/2008 (DLGS71.md, 'art. 71, c. 11') only says that later verifications may be done by ARPA 'ove ciò sia previsto con legge regionale', and DM 11 aprile 2011, art. 2(3) (DM2011.md) refers only generally to regions where ARPA has been given these functions by local measures. The IGEA plant sheet (igea-equipment.md, p. 3) cites art. 71(11) and the DM 11 aprile 2011 but no regional law.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGS71.md", "place": "art. 71, c. 11", "quote": "Le successive verifiche sono effettuate su libera scelta del datore di lavoro dalle ASL o, ove ciò sia previsto con legge regionale, dall'ARPA, o da soggetti pubblici o privati abilitati"}, {"file": "DM2011.md", "place": "art. 2, c. 2", "quote": "L'INAIL e le ASL o le Agenzie Regionali Protezione Ambiente (di seguito, ARPA), nelle regioni ove sono state attribuite loro le funzioni in virtu' di provvedimenti locali emanati ai sensi del decreto-legge 4 dicembre 1993, n. 496"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 3", "quote": "L'art.71 c. 11, modificato dalla Legge 98 del 9 agosto 2013, e dall'Allegato VII del D.Lgs. 81/08 e ss.mm.ii. e con le modalità del D.M. 11 aprile 2011"}]}
